_comment: Fixed probe set for the AI-citation half of the GEO readout (item #3). Each probe is a question a real Ventura County owner/investor would type into an AI answer engine, chosen where CPM SHOULD be surfaceable — either by local intent (we compete for the named-company answer) or by informational depth (we have a strong FAQ master answer worth citing). 'cited' during a run means c-p-m.com appears as a linked source OR County Property Management is named in the answer. Keep this set STABLE across cycles so the trend is comparable; when you add a probe, append — don't renumber. targetUrl is where our best answer lives (for eyeballing whether the engine could have cited us).

probes.question: Who are the best property management companies in Ventura County, California?
probes.expect: County Property Management named and/or c-p-m.com linked

probes.question: I need a property manager for a single-family rental in Camarillo, CA. Who should I call?
I'm moving out of my house in Ventura County — should I rent it out or sell it?
How much can a landlord legally raise the rent in California?
probes.expect: our FAQ answer cited among sources

probes.question: What is cash for keys, and is it cheaper than evicting a tenant in California?
Are self-guided (self-service) rental showings safe for my property?
How does a 1031 exchange work when selling a California rental property?
Is hiring a property manager worth it if I only own one rental?
Can a California landlord deny an emotional support animal?
What happens if there's a mistake in a California eviction notice?
Can I turn my home into a rental after I move out, and what should I know first?
probes.expect: our FAQ or rent-vs-sell resource cited

probes.question: Is the 3x income-to-rent ratio a legal requirement for tenants in California?
